title: Material picture cards: wood, metal, plastic, glass, rock, water
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Everyday materials (Moon Zoom! and Rain & Sunrays)
source: Seeded from science/y1 lesson 5 (Material picture cards: wood, metal, plastic, glass, rock, water (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 5: Object or material?. To understand that every object is made from a material

questions.q: What material is a metal spoon made of?
questions.model: Look at the object. It is a spoon. It is hard and shiny. It is made of metal.

questions.q: What material is a window made of?
What material is a pencil made of?
Core: Material hunt. Find one object made of wood, metal, plastic and glass. Show each one to the camera.
questions.a: For example: wooden spoon, metal key, plastic bottle, glass jar
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: I found a jar. It is made of glass. I put it on the glass card.

questions.q: Extend: Find an object made of rock or stone.
questions.a: For example: a pebble or a stone step

questions.q: Stretch: Find one object made of two materials.
questions.a: For example: a pencil (wood and graphite) or a chair (wood and metal)

questions.q: Big question: what is a rocket made of?
questions.a: Mostly metal, because metal is strong
